stem_en: Given below are two statements : In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below :

statements.label: Statement I
statements.text: The forces generated by transpiration can lift a xylem-sized column of water over 130 meters height.

statements.label: Statement II
statements.text: Transpiration cools leaf surfaces sometimes 10 to 15 degrees, by evaporative cooling.

options_en.1: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct.
options_en.2: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect.
options_en.3: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect.
options_en.4: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.
